title: Pretty section rendering must not bypass chat cards for active search matches
answers: search in trace pretty view hides chat cards
highlighting a match in trace input shows raw fields instead of chat
active match trace search breaks Pretty rendering
Pretty mode should keep chat cards while searching
body:
Invariant: In Pretty render mode, renderSectionPayload must always produce the chat cards plus the filtered non-chat fields. It must not fall back to a raw field list just because a search match is active in that section.
Enforced at: ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView.tsx:renderSectionPayload. The early return on `isActiveMatchSpan && activeMatch.section === section` that called renderPrettyFields over the full list was removed.
What breaks if skipped: With an active match, the section switches to the unfiltered field list, so chat messages appear as duplicated or raw content and the chat layout disappears while searching.
Tests: ModelTraceExplorerRightPane.test.tsx covers this by rerendering with searchFilter and activeMatch set, then checking that the User and Assistant role labels still appear exactly once.
applies: Search and active-match highlighting in the trace span detail Pretty view.
says: Searching inside the trace details pane collapses formatted chat cards into raw text.
Highlighting a search match in span details breaks the pretty conversation view.
Keep user and assistant message bubbles visible while filtering trace text.
Active search results in model trace view should not duplicate chat message fields.
search: In the model trace explorer span detail Pretty view, renderSectionPayload must retain chat cards alongside filtered non-chat fields even when a search match is active in that section. Enforced in ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView.tsx:renderSectionPayload by removing the active match early return that fell back to renderPrettyFields on the full list. Applies to active-match search highlighting in Pretty mode, preventing chat layouts from collapsing into duplicate raw fields, as tested in ModelTraceExplorerRightPane.test.tsx.
